narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.56 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1716-0.1789 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.1817; the first objective pays 2.68R at 0.1692.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.1716-0.1789
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1817 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
